walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK is getting older.

Over 18% are aged 65+ and the share keeps rising.

This stresses the NHS and pension system.

Migration is reshaping the population.

The 2004 EU enlargement brought hundreds of thousands of Poles.

After Brexit in 2020, EU arrivals fell but non-EU rose.

Wealth is not even.

The North-South divide shows higher incomes in the South East.

Areas like Manchester still buck the trend with thriving services.

mcqs.q: What causes global sea level rise?
options: It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Sea level rises mainly because Arctic sea ice is melting.
Sea level rises because of underwater volcanoes pushing it up.
Two main factors: thermal expansion of warming seawater, and the melting of land-based ice (glaciers and ice sheets) adding water to oceans.

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Climate change only happens in summer.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.

mcqs.q: Why can a cold winter NOT disprove climate change?
options: A really cold winter proves global warming is not happening.
Climate change only happens in summer.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Climate is the long-term statistical average; a single cold winter is a weather event. Climate change is the trend in averages and extremes over decades, not the absence of cold days.
